00076 #define ExpandingMulAddUGenDeclaration(UGEN_NAME, ARGS_CALL, ARGS_CALL_MULADD, ARGS_DECLARE, ARGS_DECLARE_MULADD, DOCS)                 \

00085                                                                                                                                         \
00086                                                                                         \
00092         static inline UGen AR ARGS_DECLARE_MULADD throw()                                                                               \
00093         {                                                                                                                               \
00094             const int mulNumChannels = Mul_Arg.getNumChannels();                                                                        \
00095             const int addNumChannels = Add_Arg.getNumChannels();                                                                        \
00096             const bool mulIsOne = (mulNumChannels == 1 && Mul_Arg.isConst(0) && Mul_Arg.getValue(0) == 1.f);                            \
00097             const bool addIsZero = (addNumChannels == 1 && Add_Arg.isConst(0) && Add_Arg.getValue(0) == 0.f);                           \
00098             UGen source = UGEN_NAME ARGS_CALL;                                                                                          \
00099             if(mulIsOne && addIsZero)                                                                                                   \
00100                 return source;                                                                                                          \
00101             else if(addIsZero) {                                                                                                        \
00102                 while(source.getNumChannels() < mulNumChannels) source <<= UGEN_NAME ARGS_CALL;                                         \
00103                 const int numChannels = ugen::max(mulNumChannels, source.getNumChannels());                                             \
00104                 return source.withNumChannels(numChannels) * Mul_Arg;                                                                   \
00105             } else if(mulIsOne) {                                                                                                       \
00106                 while(source.getNumChannels() < addNumChannels) source <<= UGEN_NAME ARGS_CALL;                                         \
00107                 const int numChannels = ugen::max(addNumChannels, source.getNumChannels());                                             \
00108                 return source.withNumChannels(numChannels) + Add_Arg;                                                                   \
00109             } else {                                                                                                                    \
00110                 const int numMulAddChannels = ugen::max(mulNumChannels, addNumChannels);                                                \
00111                 while(source.getNumChannels() < numMulAddChannels) source <<= UGEN_NAME ARGS_CALL;                                      \
00112                 const int numChannels = ugen::max(numMulAddChannels, source.getNumChannels());                                          \
00113                 return MulAdd (source.withNumChannels(numChannels), MulAdd_ArgsCall);                                                   \
00114             }                                                                                                                           \
00115             return source;                                                                                                              \
00116         }                                                                                                                               \
00117                                                                                                                                         \
00118                                                                                         \

00125         {                                                                                                                               \
00126             const int mulNumChannels = Mul_Arg.getNumChannels();                                                                        \
00127             const int addNumChannels = Add_Arg.getNumChannels();                                                                        \

00129             const bool addIsZero = (addNumChannels == 1 && Add_Arg.isConst(0) && Add_Arg.getValue(0) == 0.f);                           \
00130             UGen source = UGEN_NAME ARGS_CALL;                                                                                          \
00131             if(mulIsOne && addIsZero)                                                                                                   \

00134                 while(source.getNumChannels() < mulNumChannels) source <<= UGEN_NAME ARGS_CALL;                                         \
00135                 const int numChannels = ugen::max(mulNumChannels, source.getNumChannels());                                             \
00136                 return UGen(source.withNumChannels(numChannels) * Mul_Arg).kr();                                                        \
00137             } else if(mulIsOne) {                                                                                                       \
00138                 while(source.getNumChannels() < addNumChannels) source <<= UGEN_NAME ARGS_CALL;                                         \
00139                 const int numChannels = ugen::max(addNumChannels, source.getNumChannels());                                             \
00140                 return UGen(source.withNumChannels(numChannels) + Add_Arg).kr();                                                        \

00142                 const int numMulAddChannels = ugen::max(mulNumChannels, addNumChannels);                                                \
00143                 while(source.getNumChannels() < numMulAddChannels) source <<= UGEN_NAME ARGS_CALL;                                      \
00144                 const int numChannels = ugen::max(numMulAddChannels, source.getNumChannels());                                          \
